vvb_guidance.content_verbatim_relevant: Application — August 1 – August 31 RP (Week 1, INJ-08-2026-W1): GPRX5240 offload 1 — empty scale ticket unavailable (trigger (a)). KL188 standard 29,307 lb applied. The Full ticket (no. 1312226210731, 70,760 lb, weighed 2026-07-29 16:28, tractor CH2 / trailer KL188) is on file and hyperlinked in the ops notes. Why no empty ticket is available. The tare weighing originally paired to this offload (ticket no. 1312226211738, 28,720 lb, weighed 2026-07-30 08:23, same trailer KL188) carries the commodity-field label '200228' and therefore belongs to railcar TILX200228 offload 2, to which it has been reassigned. No other KL188 tare weighing falls between this offload's Full weighing (2026-07-29 16:28) and the tare weighings already accounted to GPRX5240 offloads 2, 3 and 4, so no substitute ticket exists for this offload. Effect and direction. Substituted net = (70,760 − 29,307) lb × 0.453592 = 18,802.75 kg. The operational record carries 19,069.01 kg for this offload; the substituted value is 266.26 kg lower, i.e. the conservative direction. GPRX5240's total offloaded mass becomes 78,041.86 kg against 78,130 kg loaded per the origin BOLs — within the BOL bound, so no offload-4 cap adjustment was required for this railcar.
